lines: - Vala Glarios: "Captain Vala Glarios. So pleased to meet you. I should have expected Tenno rats among the flotsam. Sequester that Railjack for Parvos!"
- "I see you, you bastard. I see you."
- "Contact Parvos Granum immediately. Get me authorization for multiphasic ordinance. Tell him I've found that damned ghost!"
- "Their shields are down! Oh, sweet Tenno. You went and lulled the beast to sleep for me! How kind."

- "I was working in an exosuit when the Tempstarii destroyed Lucretia Platform. I drifted for days among the frozen fragments of my crew. My Sisters. I dreamed their dead, gaping mouths were singing with me yet."
- "My kind are the only monsters this System needs, Tenno. We have no time for old ghosts. I shall rip that ship to pieces and eat its heart."
- "Forget capture! We'll sift through the wreckage instead. Tracers locked. Engage."
- "Sisters! Hear me! Hound them to hell and back. By the hand of Parvos himself!"

- "Parvos Granum! This next candidate claims she shed the bonds of idleness and aspires to become your sister."
- "Candidate, you would be wise to remember your Tenets. Brother Parvos is watching."
- "Candidate, your accomplishments are many. Now prove yourself to our brother, Parvos Granum."
- "Brother! Another candidate steps forward in the hope of admission to our Sisterhood."
- "She eluded the Tenno. A strong candidate, but this was not her time."
- "The Tenno was too weak for her. We shall find her a more suitable match."
- "A draw! Impressive. Reward the candidate and return her to the queue."
- "Our candidate escaped. How embarrassing for the Tenno."
- "This Tenno is wasting your time Brother Parvos. The candidate has eluded them."
- "We came to judge this candidate, but instead, she judged this Tenno unworthy."
- "You have proven true Sister. A promotion is in order."
- "When a Sister distinguishes herself, she deserves... promotion.""'
- "I hereby promote you in rank and power. Use it."
- "Sister, we honor you with promotion to the highest rank!"
- "You now receive the highest honor the Sisterhood can bestow!"
- "This is Sister Vala Glarios. Dispatching fleet support. We stand with you."
- "Sister, you have our Brother's full support. Take what is yours."
- "Hold fast, Sister. Honor those who have gone before you!"
- "Have faith Sister! When your time comes your Sisters shall sing! But your time is not yet."
- "Authorizing protective specter deployment. I shall not lose another of my Sisters."
- "Sister, your desire has been rewarded with protection from Brother Parvos. Deploying specters. May they be your shields!"
- "Fight well Sister. Parvos send you guardian specters. Turn the strength of the Tenno back against them!"
- "Specters, stand by my Sister and shield her from all harm!"
- "Specters down. This must now be your final stand Sister."
- "Your guards have fallen. If you too must fall, exact a grievous price."
- "Specters destroyed. She has only herself now."
- "You stand undefended Sister. Show them how hard we can fight!"
